name: Rings
source: Mutable Instruments | Rings.pdf p3 (controls, inputs and outputs diagram); rings_quickstart.pdf p2
notes: Top row of five CV jacks is unlabelled on the panel (dotted lines to BRIGHTNESS, FREQUENCY, DAMPING, STRUCTURE, POSITION attenuverters). FREQ CV is normalled to a 1/12V offset. STRUM normalled to step detector on V/OCT and transient detector on IN; IN normalled to internal exciter. ODD/EVEN: with only one jack inserted both signals are mixed. Count matches VCV (8 in / 2 out).
